summary: Phase 135T independently verifies Phase 135S (Atomic Publication Rehearsal, Legacy Authority) per the 135Q contract and 135R's own verification -- re-derived directly from the frozen contract text, never accepted from 135S's own claims. Found and repaired two Blocking defects, both within the Stage 2 implementation boundary (independent verification plus bounded repair): (1) F-135T-1, a real, live-reproduced symlink-escape containment gap -- coordinator.py wrote every candidate artifact and the manifest via a bare Path.write_text/write_bytes call, bypassing persistence.write_candidate_artifact's pre-existing-symlink abort entirely (135Q section 7/25/47's required protection existed in source but was never called from the only production call site); a pre-placed symlink at a candidate artifact's target path was silently followed and the linked-to file's content overwritten. Repaired by wiring coordinator.py to call write_candidate_artifact for every candidate and the manifest; verified the attack now raises PathContainmentError and leaves the outside file untouched. (2) F-135T-2, 135S's own regression-baseline claim (5/8/10 pre-existing, sandbox-local, receipt-modeling failures across four named regression suites) did not reproduce on independent re-run. The actual failures were exactly 2, both the same parametrized test in tests/test_cltr_migration_135p_verification.py, caused directly by 135S's own F-135P-1 source fix landing without its regression test being updated -- a genuine, small, Stage-2-caused regression misclassified as inherited/unrelated. Independently confirmed via an isolated git worktree at the exact pre-135S baseline commit (7fb4dbc1), never mutating the primary repository: all 4 parametrized cases pass there; 2 fail on the unrepaired 135S tree. Repaired by correcting the two stale assertions to the genuinely-fixed classifications (report_create_recovery, manual_governed_recovery). Post-repair, all four regression suites 135S's own report names pass at 100 percent: Stage 2 focused 44/44 (28 inherited plus 16 fresh), combined migration 129/129, production CLTR combined 414/414, affected finalization 117/117, notification/marker/receipt/report 1183/1183; Fast Green 4391/4391 unchanged. Every other verification area independently confirmed by direct re-derivation and live reproduction rather than trusting 135S's claims: Stage 2 authority matrix and configuration; precondition contract attacked with missing LEGACY_COMPLETION revision, incomplete Stage 1 status, and authority-relevant mismatch; deterministic rehearsal-generation identity re-derived and confirmed stable across a fresh Python subprocess, with each of 8 bound fields independently changing the identity when varied; exact 23-item candidate inventory independently re-derived from 135Q section 9 directly (not copied from source), confirming 10 genuinely file-backed items with honest, disclosed folding of items 11-14 into other artifacts/commands (confirmed present in a real end-to-end-produced manifest, not merely in source); candidate honesty (no candidate can claim production terminal state); 19-step assembly sequence traced to code; manifest/generation-digest tamper detection confirmed via live on-disk mutation of a finalized artifact, not merely an in-memory fixture; atomic pointer publication and crash/recovery/idempotency/quarantine verified by direct source re-reading; all-four-production-entry-point wiring confirmed via a single shared coordinator call site with no entry-point branching; 135H.1 escape resistance confirmed by real call-path tracing; production side-effect, notification, marker, and receipt isolation confirmed via a live filesystem-snapshot-equality test (byte-for-byte unchanged before/after CLI invocation) plus import-graph proof (zero subprocess/socket/telegram-import occurrences); no-execution boundary confirmed structurally, not merely by a passing test. F-135R-1 through F-135R-4 and F-135P-1 through F-135P-4 dispositions independently re-verified against current source. No production phase report, completion metadata, Architecture Status, checkpoint, marker, or receipt was created or modified by Stage 2. No production pointer changed because of Stage 2. No external delivery originated from Stage 2. No Stage 3 implementation, authority cutover, legacy demotion, or legacy retirement occurred. No execution capability was introduced. Runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS (independent verification plus bounded repair). Recommends 135U -- Rollback Rehearsal Implementation and Independent Verification next (a design judgment for the next phase to confirm, not asserted as final).
